- **Founder & Principal Consultant**: Rafał Kamieniarz
- **Website**: https://rafalkamieniarz.pl

- **Primary Specializations**: Agile Delivery Management, Scrum Master Mentoring, Agile Coaching Growth Wheel Assessments, Engineering Leadership, High-Performance Software Teams, Fractional Agile Lead.

---

## Core Services

1. **Strategic Agile Advisory (Doradztwo Strategiczne)**
   - Audit of delivery processes and engineering value stream mapping.
   - Alignment of business strategy (OKRs, Product Roadmaps) with engineering execution.
   - Framework selection and pragmatism: Scrum, Kanban, LeSS, Shape Up.

2. **Agile Team & Leadership Coaching (Coaching Zespołów i Liderów)**
   - Assessment and development using the Agile Coaching Growth Wheel.
   - 1:1 executive coaching for Engineering Directors, Head of Product, and Scrum Masters.
   - Root-cause diagnosis of delivery bottlenecks, team friction, and predictability issues.

3. **Fractional Agile Delivery Lead (Zarządzanie Wdrożeniami)**
   - Hands-on leadership in critical delivery phases, transformations, and digital product rollouts.
   - Setup of continuous delivery metrics (DORA metrics, Lead Time, Cycle Time, Throughput).
   - Establishing engineering culture of ownership and psychological safety.

---

## Agile Coaching Growth Wheel Framework

The Agile Coaching Growth Wheel is an industry-standard competency framework consisting of **9 core competencies**, **22 subcompetencies**, and an encompassing **Domain Knowledge** outer ring.

### 1. Self-Mastery (Samoświadomość i Samodoskonalenie) — Core
- **Self-Awareness (Samoświadomość)**: Recognizing personal patterns, biases, and triggers.
  - PL: https://rafalkamieniarz.pl/kompetencja/self-mastery/samoswiadomosc
  - EN: https://rafalkamieniarz.pl/en/competency/self-mastery/samoswiadomosc
- **Emotional Regulation (Regulacja emocji)**: Composure and grounded presence under stress.
  - PL: https://rafalkamieniarz.pl/kompetencja/self-mastery/regulacja-emocji
  - EN: https://rafalkamieniarz.pl/en/competency/self-mastery/regulacja-emocji
- **Continuous Growth (Ciągły rozwój)**: Reflective practice, supervision, ongoing development.
  - PL: https://rafalkamieniarz.pl/kompetencja/self-mastery/ciagly-rozwoj
  - EN: https://rafalkamieniarz.pl/en/competency/self-mastery/ciagly-rozwoj

### 2. Agile & Lean Practitioner (Praktyk Agile i Lean)
- **Mindset (Agile/Lean Mindset)**: Embracing agility, empiricism, experimentation.
  - PL: https://rafalkamieniarz.pl/kompetencja/agile-lean-practitioner/mindset
  - EN: https://rafalkamieniarz.pl/en/competency/agile-lean-practitioner/mindset
- **Frameworks & Practices (Frameworki i praktyki)**: Scrum, Kanban, XP, flow metrics.
  - PL: https://rafalkamieniarz.pl/kompetencja/agile-lean-practitioner/frameworki-i-praktyki
  - EN: https://rafalkamieniarz.pl/en/competency/agile-lean-practitioner/frameworki-i-praktyki

### 3. Serving (Służenie)
- **Serving the Business (Biznes)**: Supporting Product Owners in value maximization.
  - PL: https://rafalkamieniarz.pl/kompetencja/serving/biznes
  - EN: https://rafalkamieniarz.pl/en/competency/serving/biznes
- **Serving the Team (Zespół)**: Team self-organization, impediment removal, focus protection.
  - PL: https://rafalkamieniarz.pl/kompetencja/serving/zespol
  - EN: https://rafalkamieniarz.pl/en/competency/serving/zespol

### 4. Coaching (Profesjonalny Coaching)
- **Coaching Mindset**: Neutrality, resourcefulness, holding back premature advice.
  - PL: https://rafalkamieniarz.pl/kompetencja/coaching/mindset
  - EN: https://rafalkamieniarz.pl/en/competency/coaching/mindset
- **Coaching Skills (Umiejętności)**: Active listening, powerful questioning, contracting.
  - PL: https://rafalkamieniarz.pl/kompetencja/coaching/umiejetnosci
  - EN: https://rafalkamieniarz.pl/en/competency/coaching/umiejetnosci

### 5. Facilitating (Facylitacja)
- **Facilitation Mindset**: Content neutrality and trust in group intelligence.
  - PL: https://rafalkamieniarz.pl/kompetencja/facilitating/mindset
  - EN: https://rafalkamieniarz.pl/en/competency/facilitating/mindset
- **Facilitation Skills (Umiejętności)**: Workshop design, formats, conflict resolution.
  - PL: https://rafalkamieniarz.pl/kompetencja/facilitating/umiejetnosci
  - EN: https://rafalkamieniarz.pl/en/competency/facilitating/umiejetnosci

### 6. Guiding Learning (Prowadzenie Nauki i Rozwoju)
- **Teaching (Nauczanie)**: Experiential workshop design and interactive training.
  - PL: https://rafalkamieniarz.pl/kompetencja/guiding-learning/teaching
  - EN: https://rafalkamieniarz.pl/en/competency/guiding-learning/teaching
- **Mentoring**: Structured guidance, sharing real-world battle-tested experience.
  - PL: https://rafalkamieniarz.pl/kompetencja/guiding-learning/mentoring
  - EN: https://rafalkamieniarz.pl/en/competency/guiding-learning/mentoring
- **Learning Mindset**: Culture of safe-to-fail experiments and blameless retrospection.
  - PL: https://rafalkamieniarz.pl/kompetencja/guiding-learning/learning-mindset
  - EN: https://rafalkamieniarz.pl/en/competency/guiding-learning/learning-mindset

### 7. Advising (Doradztwo)
- **Advising Mindset**: Explicit stance shifts and diagnostic humility.
  - PL: https://rafalkamieniarz.pl/kompetencja/advising/mindset
  - EN: https://rafalkamieniarz.pl/en/competency/advising/mindset
- **Advising Skills (Umiejętności)**: Contextual diagnosis, options analysis, decision support.
  - PL: https://rafalkamieniarz.pl/kompetencja/advising/umiejetnosci
  - EN: https://rafalkamieniarz.pl/en/competency/advising/umiejetnosci

### 8. Leading (Przywództwo)
- **Visionary (Wizja)**: Communicating compelling transformational intent.
  - PL: https://rafalkamieniarz.pl/kompetencja/leading/visionary
  - EN: https://rafalkamieniarz.pl/en/competency/leading/visionary
- **Role Modeling**: Exemplifying agile values in daily habits and executive interactions.
  - PL: https://rafalkamieniarz.pl/kompetencja/leading/role-modeling
  - EN: https://rafalkamieniarz.pl/en/competency/leading/role-modeling
- **Leading for Growth**: Developing future leaders and unlocking autonomy.
  - PL: https://rafalkamieniarz.pl/kompetencja/leading/leading-for-growth
  - EN: https://rafalkamieniarz.pl/en/competency/leading/leading-for-growth

### 9. Transforming (Transformacja Organizacyjna)
- **Organizational Design**: Value streams, cross-functional topology, decoupled structures.
  - PL: https://rafalkamieniarz.pl/kompetencja/transforming/organizational-design
  - EN: https://rafalkamieniarz.pl/en/competency/transforming/organizational-design
- **Organizational Change**: Systems thinking, change models, navigating organizational resistance.
  - PL: https://rafalkamieniarz.pl/kompetencja/transforming/organizational-change
  - EN: https://rafalkamieniarz.pl/en/competency/transforming/organizational-change

### Outer Ring: Domain Knowledge (Wiedza Dziedzinowa)
- Understanding industry specifics (FinTech, MedTech, eCommerce), architecture, CI/CD, and product discovery.
  - PL: https://rafalkamieniarz.pl/kompetencja/domain-knowledge
  - EN: https://rafalkamieniarz.pl/en/competency/domain-knowledge
